summary: Retested the fixed new-order flow and the requested public API/UI behavior. Backend root and order validation passed; catalog search/filter, cart totals, delivery/pickup WhatsApp payloads, form reset, and mobile overflow all passed.
seed_data_creation: The existing regression test created one TEST-prefixed order through the public API.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New-order reset regression is verified: name, phone, address, notes, and default pickup state reset; pickup payload excludes the previous delivery address. Mobile viewport has no horizontal overflow.
rca of the issue: Previous stale-address behavior was caused by the new-order handler clearing only cart and step. The current handler also calls setForm(initialForm), which removes prior customer and delivery state before the next order.
